title: Incremental parallel media audit
summary: Reduce audit filesystem work, sample probe identity once per lookup, and prefetch uncached ffprobe results with two bounded workers before deterministic classification/reporting.
reason: Audit enumeration performed a second metadata pass, cache lookups reread sampled media regions, and uncached ffprobe processes ran serially.
behavior_before: Enumeration serialized paths and repeated Get-Item, cache hits/misses sampled identity repeatedly, and each uncached ffprobe completed before the next began.
behavior_after: Enumeration returns filtered identity metadata directly, each lookup reuses one identity, and 1-8 validated probe workers (default 2) feed the unchanged sequential classifier and report writer.
manual_validation: three generated 12-file audit pairs: 1 worker 3739.0/3113.0/3008.3 ms; 2 workers 1838.9/1963.3/1957.9 ms; all exits 0 with identical 12-row classification and 12 cache writes
rollback_plan: Restore per-call probe identity calculation, the prior path-plus-Get-Item enumeration, remove ProbeConcurrency/prefetch, and remove concurrency report metadata/tests.
notes:
Reuse one sampled source identity across cache lookup and write paths.
Return filtered media metadata directly from bounded enumeration without a second Get-Item pass.
Add bounded parallel ffprobe prefetch while preserving sequential deterministic classification.
Add validated ProbeConcurrency input, prefetched probe handoff, and concurrency evidence while preserving existing TX3G edits.
Record probe concurrency in JSON report metadata.
Prove one identity sample per lookup, cache reuse, and direct bounded enumeration metadata.
Document current bounded concurrency and identity/enumeration behavior.
Refresh generated summary for the performance change.
